description: Run one action, after the person agreed to the price capability_inspect gave. Give id, arguments and max_cost_usd from that price: a run that would cost more is refused with nothing charged. Only a delivered result is charged; a run that finds nothing costs nothing. It waits up to wait_seconds (default 20, at most 50; 0 answers at once) and answers the result in plain words with its rows; a longer run answers its execution_id for capability_run_status. An answer with rows has results_page and csv_url: give the person those links instead of writing the rows out again. idempotency_key makes a retry safe (the same key answers the same run, no new charge). Give tag (such as a customer name) to see usage and cost by tag in Activity. A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: rows, or rows_text (paste up to 100 rows as text), instead of arguments; without confirm it answers the price of the list, with confirm true it runs it. NOT for: the same action over many inputs, which is run_batch, or a ready-made job, which is run_recipe.

arguments.description: The capability's inputs, by name. Required unless rows, rows_text or run_id is given; with a list, {"verify": true} checks every found email.

capability_id.description: Instead of id: a v2 capability id from capability_run_status (no execution_id).

confirm.description: With rows or rows_text: true runs the list once the person agrees to its quote. Left out, the answer is the quote and nothing runs. The same list sent again the same UTC day answers the first run's receipt and neither runs nor charges again; a new idempotency_key runs it again.

endpoint_ids.description: Optional, for builders: run only on these providers, by the endpoint ids capability_inspect lists when given endpoint ids. Leave it out to let Ahel pick (the default).

exclude_endpoint_ids.description: Optional, for builders: never use these providers, by the endpoint ids capability_inspect lists when given endpoint ids. Ahel picks among the rest.

id.description: An action id or tool id from capability_search or capability_inspect.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this run, 8 to 200 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. Sending the same call again with the same key answers the same run with no new charge; the same key with different inputs is refused.

max_cost_usd.description: Optional: the most this run may cost, in USD, such as "0.05". capability_inspect's next names the quoted maximum. Ahel uses only providers that fit under it, and when none does the run is refused with nothing run or charged. One run only; a list has its own quote and confirm.

rows.description: A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: 1 to 100 rows, each run once as its own run with its own exact cost. One object per row, such as {"name": "Jane Doe", "domain": "example.com"} or {"name": "Example Ltd", "country": "GB"}.

rows_text.description: A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: 1 to 100 rows, each run once as its own run with its own exact cost. Instead of rows: paste up to 100 rows as text, one per line ("Jane Doe, example.com"; "Example Ltd, GB") or a CSV with a header row (name, domain, linkedin_url; name, country).

run_id.description: With id: the run_id a list's receipt answered, to read its rows still running and start the rest. Rows already run are never run twice.

tag.description: Optional: a label for this run, such as the customer or project it is for: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Activity shows runs and cost by tag. It stays in Ahel and is never sent to a provider.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest the run may take, 1-180 seconds. Default: the provider's own (60, more for slow sources).

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait for the run to finish and answer its rows here, 0-50 seconds. Default 20; 0 answers the execution id at once. A list waits up to 45 s.

name: run_capability
title: Run an action
